t: The Lexco fixed fire rated trimless downlight offers a concealed lighting solution for a seamless ceiling finish. This robust downlight is fire rated for 30, 60, and 90 minutes, providing enhanced safety for both domestic and commercial installations. Its IP65 rating makes it ideal for use in bathroom Zone 2, kitchens, and other areas requiring moisture protection. Designed for plastering directly into the ceiling, it allows for later bulb installation. Featuring a durable plastic body and convenient loop in, loop out wiring, this downlight requires one GU10 bulb (sold separately), and operates on a 220-240 V mains power supply.
